records.title: 2026 State of Community Luncheon
records.location: Tretheway Pavilion, Spearfish City Park 115 S Canyon St, Spearfish SD 57783
records.fees: Registrations required by Thursday, October 29 $28 per ticket Call (605) 642-2626 Order online at SpearfishChamber.org
records.description: The State of Community Luncheon serves as an avenue to keep Spearfishians informed on the topics that face the business community, the private sector, and our local government. Speakers will discuss opportunities, challenges, and projects that affect our residents, businesses, and the entire community. Speakers: John Senden, Mayor of Spearfish Steve Elliott, President of Black Hills State University Thomas Worsley, President of Monument Health Spearfish Hospital & Monument Health Network Nick Gottlob, Superintendent of Spearfish School District Doors open at 11:15 AM Lunch (buffet) is served at 11:30 AM Speakers present at Noon Thank you to our event sponsors: Bluepeak, Black Hills Energy, The Blind Guy, Black Hills Federal Credit Union, Platinum Car Brokers, SDN Communications, Monument Health, Highmark Credit Union, Pioneer Bank & Trust, McGough Construction, Sundance State Bank, Lighthouse Construction, SoDak Title, Coeur Wharf, and Wolff's Plumbing & Heating.

records.title: Young Life Trivia Night
records.location: Holliday Inn Spearfish Convention Center 305 N 27th St, Spearfish, SD 57783
records.fees: This is a fundraising dinner and event, but we welcome everyone to come for free.
records.description: DATE: Saturday, November 7th TIME: Doors Open at - 5pm THEME: Western - Cowboys & Cowgirls ?? INTRO: TRIVIA NIGHT is an annual fundraising event benefiting Spearfish Young Life. Young Life is a 501(c)(3) Nonprofit funded by donors and fundraising efforts in our local communities. This event helps sustain the mission of Young Life - To introduce adolescents to Jesus and help them grown in their faith. Throughout the night guests will be invited to experience the following: • A delicious meal • A fun game with friends • A guest speaker sharing about what Young Life is and how you can partner with us. You might be lucky enough to win a prize too! We are excited to share in the fun with you and so grateful to have your support.

records.title: Tech Safety/Cybersecurity for Seniors
records.location: Spearfish Chamber of Commerce; 106 W Kansas St, Spearfish, SD 57783
records.description: Are you 50 or older and struggling with Technology? This is the class for you. We breakdown cybersecurity and online activities into simple, everyday steps. No confusing jargon-- just practical, easy-to-learn habits to lock down your personal information and safely navigate our online world. Jeanne will be joined by Erika Schumacher and Michael Hauge, some of Community Education's top tech gurus. This session will be fun and interactive, and it is the future – come be a part of it! Bring your devices – Smartphones, iPads, and laptops.
